query_5.sql: SELECT sg.StudentID, p.LastName, p.FirstName, sg.Grade FROM StudentGrade sg JOIN Person p ON sg.StudentID = p.PersonID

query_6.sql: SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, oc.Location, oc.Days FROM Course c INNER JOIN OnsiteCourse oc ON c.CourseID = oc.CourseID

query_7.sql: SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, oc.URL FROM Course c INNER JOIN OnlineCourse oc ON c.CourseID = oc.CourseID

query_8.sql: SELECT p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName, AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) AS Promedio FROM Person p JOIN StudentGrade sg ON p.PersonID = sg.StudentID GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName

query_9.sql: SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title FROM Course c WHERE c.CourseID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CourseID FROM StudentGrade)

query_10.enunciado: Instructores que imparten más de un curso
query_10.sql: SELECT p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName, COUNT(ci.CourseID) AS CursosImpartidos FROM Person p JOIN CourseInstructor ci ON p.PersonID = ci.PersonID GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName HAVING COUNT(ci.CourseID) > 1

query_11.sql: SELECT TOP 5 c.CourseID, c.Title, COUNT(sg.StudentID) AS TotalEstudiantes FROM Course c JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY c.CourseID, c.Title ORDER BY TotalEstudiantes DESC

query_12.sql: SELECT p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName FROM Person p WHERE p.PersonType = 'Student' AND p.PersonID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT StudentID FROM StudentGrade)

query_13.sql: SELECT d.Name AS Departamento, c.Title AS Curso FROM Department d JOIN Course c ON d.DepartmentID = c.DepartmentID

query_14.sql: SELECT c.Title, p.LastName, p.FirstName, sg.Grade FROM Course c JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID JOIN Person p ON sg.StudentID = p.PersonID ORDER BY c.Title, sg.Grade DESC

query_15.sql: SELECT d.Name AS Departamento, COUNT(c.CourseID) AS TotalCursos FROM Department d LEFT JOIN Course c ON d.DepartmentID = c.DepartmentID GROUP BY d.Name ORDER BY TotalCursos DESC

query_16.enunciado: Genera una lista de las ciudades con establecimientos donde se venden programas, sin que aparezcan valores duplicados
query_16.sql:
SELECT c.ciudad
FROM Comercio c 
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM distribuye d WHERE d.cif = c.cif)

query_17.sql: SELECT p.LastName, p.FirstName, SUM(c.Credits) AS CreditosTotales FROM Person p JOIN StudentGrade sg ON p.PersonID = sg.StudentID JOIN Course c ON sg.CourseID = c.CourseID GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName ORDER BY CreditosTotales DESC

query_18.sql: SELECT c.Title, oc.URL FROM Course c JOIN OnlineCourse oc ON c.CourseID = oc.CourseID WHERE oc.URL IS NOT NULL

query_19.sql: SELECT Grade, COUNT(*) AS Cantidad FROM StudentGrade GROUP BY Grade ORDER BY Grade

query_20.sql: SELECT p.LastName, p.FirstName, AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) AS Promedio FROM Person p JOIN StudentGrade sg ON p.PersonID = sg.StudentID GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName HAVING AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) > 85 ORDER BY Promedio DESC

query_21.enunciado: Cursos que no tienen instructor asignado
query_21.sql: SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title FROM Course c WHERE c.CourseID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CourseID FROM CourseInstructor)

query_22.sql: SELECT p.LastName AS Instructor, c.Title AS Curso, d.Name AS Departamento FROM Person p JOIN CourseInstructor ci ON p.PersonID = ci.PersonID JOIN Course c ON ci.CourseID = c.CourseID JOIN Department d ON c.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID ORDER BY p.LastName

query_23.sql: SELECT DISTINCT Location, COUNT(CourseID) AS CantidadCursos FROM OnsiteCourse GROUP BY Location ORDER BY CantidadCursos DESC

query_24.sql: SELECT d.Name AS Departamento, COUNT(DISTINCT sg.StudentID) AS TotalEstudiantes FROM Department d JOIN Course c ON d.DepartmentID = c.DepartmentID JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY d.Name ORDER BY TotalEstudiantes DESC

query_25.sql: WITH CursosConEstudiantes AS (SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, COUNT(sg.StudentID) AS TotalEstudiantes FROM Course c LEFT JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY c.CourseID, c.Title) SELECT * FROM CursosConEstudiantes WHERE TotalEstudiantes > 0 ORDER BY TotalEstudiantes DESC

query_26.sql: WITH PromedioEstudiante AS (SELECT StudentID, AVG(CAST(Grade AS FLOAT)) AS Promedio FROM StudentGrade GROUP BY StudentID) SELECT p.LastName, p.FirstName, pe.Promedio FROM Person p JOIN PromedioEstudiante pe ON p.PersonID = pe.StudentID WHERE pe.Promedio > 80 ORDER BY pe.Promedio DESC

query_27.sql: WITH PopularidadCursos AS (SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, COUNT(sg.StudentID) AS Inscritos FROM Course c LEFT JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY c.CourseID, c.Title) SELECT * FROM PopularidadCursos WHERE Inscritos > 5 ORDER BY Inscritos DESC

query_28.sql: WITH InstructoresMultiples AS (SELECT ci.PersonID, COUNT(ci.CourseID) AS TotalCursos FROM CourseInstructor ci GROUP BY ci.PersonID HAVING COUNT(ci.CourseID) > 1) SELECT p.LastName, p.FirstName, im.TotalCursos FROM Person p JOIN InstructoresMultiples im ON p.PersonID = im.PersonID ORDER BY im.TotalCursos DESC

query_29.sql: SELECT p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName, COUNT(sg.CourseID) AS CursosTomados FROM Person p JOIN StudentGrade sg ON p.PersonID = sg.StudentID GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName HAVING COUNT(sg.CourseID) > 3 ORDER BY CursosTomados DESC

query_30.sql: SELECT c.Title, MIN(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) AS CalificacionMin, MAX(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) AS CalificacionMax, AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) AS CalificacionProm FROM Course c JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY c.CourseID, c.Title ORDER BY CalificacionProm DESC

query_31.sql: SELECT c.Title, oc.Days, oc.Location FROM Course c INNER JOIN OnsiteCourse oc ON c.CourseID = oc.CourseID WHERE oc.Days LIKE '%M%' ORDER BY oc.Days

query_32.sql: SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, COUNT(sg.StudentID) AS TotalEstudiantes FROM Course c LEFT JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY c.CourseID, c.Title ORDER BY TotalEstudiantes DESC

query_33.enunciado: Detalle completo de calificaciones con nombres
query_33.sql: SELECT c.Title AS Curso, p.LastName AS Apellido, p.FirstName AS Nombre, sg.Grade AS Calificacion FROM Course c JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID JOIN Person p ON sg.StudentID = p.PersonID ORDER BY c.Title, p.LastName

query_34.sql: SELECT c.Title, oc.URL FROM Course c JOIN OnlineCourse oc ON c.CourseID = oc.CourseID

query_35.sql: SELECT 'Onsite' AS TipoCurso, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM OnsiteCourse UNION SELECT 'Online' AS TipoCurso, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM OnlineCourse

query_36.sql: SELECT p.LastName, p.FirstName, COUNT(ci.CourseID) AS CursosQueImparte FROM Person p LEFT JOIN CourseInstructor ci ON p.PersonID = ci.PersonID WHERE p.PersonType = 'Instructor' GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName ORDER BY CursosQueImparte DESC

query_37.enunciado: Consulta compleja: Cursos, estudiantes e instructores
query_37.sql: WITH Cursos AS (SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title FROM Course c), AlumnosPorCurso AS (SELECT sg.CourseID, sg.StudentID, p.LastName + ', ' + p.FirstName AS Estudiante FROM StudentGrade sg JOIN Person p ON sg.StudentID = p.PersonID), InstructoresPorCurso AS (SELECT ci.CourseID, p.LastName + ', ' + p.FirstName AS Instructor FROM CourseInstructor ci JOIN Person p ON ci.PersonID = p.PersonID) SELECT cu.CourseID, cu.Title, a.Estudiante, i.Instructor FROM Cursos cu LEFT JOIN AlumnosPorCurso a ON cu.CourseID = a.CourseID LEFT JOIN InstructoresPorCurso i ON cu.CourseID = i.CourseID ORDER BY cu.Title, a.Estudiante

query_38.sql: SELECT TOP 10 p.LastName, p.FirstName, AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) AS Promedio FROM Person p JOIN StudentGrade sg ON p.PersonID = sg.StudentID GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName ORDER BY Promedio DESC

query_39.sql: SELECT Days, COUNT(*) AS CantidadCursos FROM OnsiteCourse GROUP BY Days ORDER BY CantidadCursos DESC

query_40.sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName FROM Person p JOIN StudentGrade sg ON p.PersonID = sg.StudentID WHERE sg.CourseID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT CourseID FROM CourseInstructor)

query_41.sql: SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, COUNT(sg.StudentID) AS Demanda FROM Course c JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY c.CourseID, c.Title HAVING COUNT(sg.StudentID) > 10 ORDER BY Demanda DESC

query_42.sql: SELECT d.Name AS Departamento, COUNT(sg.StudentID) AS TotalMatriculas FROM Department d JOIN Course c ON d.DepartmentID = c.DepartmentID JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY d.Name ORDER BY TotalMatriculas DESC

query_43.enunciado: Cursos que no son ni Onsite ni Online
query_43.sql: SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title FROM Course c WHERE c.CourseID NOT IN (SELECT CourseID FROM OnsiteCourse) AND c.CourseID NOT IN (SELECT CourseID FROM OnlineCourse)

query_44.sql: SELECT p.LastName, p.FirstName, AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) AS PromedioCalificaciones FROM Person p JOIN CourseInstructor ci ON p.PersonID = ci.PersonID JOIN StudentGrade sg ON ci.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName ORDER BY PromedioCalificaciones DESC

query_45.sql: SELECT DISTINCT Location FROM OnsiteCourse WHERE Location IS NOT NULL ORDER BY Location

query_46.sql: SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, (SELECT sg.StudentID, p.LastName FROM StudentGrade sg JOIN Person p ON sg.StudentID = p.PersonID WHERE sg.CourseID = c.CourseID FOR JSON AUTO) AS Estudiantes FROM Course c FOR JSON AUTO

query_47.sql: SELECT c.CourseID, c.Title, (SELECT sg.StudentID, p.LastName FROM StudentGrade sg JOIN Person p ON sg.StudentID = p.PersonID WHERE sg.CourseID = c.CourseID FOR XML AUTO) AS Estudiantes FROM Course c FOR XML AUTO

query_48.sql: SELECT CourseID, Title, Credits FROM Course WHERE Credits <= 0 OR Credits IS NULL

query_49.sql: SELECT * INTO StudentGrade_Backup FROM StudentGrade WHERE 1=0

query_50.enunciado: Consulta de auditoría: Calificaciones modificadas recientemente
query_50.sql: SELECT * FROM StudentGrade WHERE ModifiedDate >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, GETDATE())

query_51.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(GETDATE()) - YEAR(BirthDate) < 20 THEN 'Menos de 20' WHEN YEAR(GETDATE()) - YEAR(BirthDate) BETWEEN 20 AND 25 THEN '20-25' ELSE 'Más de 25' END AS RangoEdad, COUNT(*) AS Cantidad FROM Person WHERE PersonType = 'Student' GROUP BY CASE WHEN YEAR(GETDATE()) - YEAR(BirthDate) < 20 THEN 'Menos de 20' WHEN YEAR(GETDATE()) - YEAR(BirthDate) BETWEEN 20 AND 25 THEN '20-25' ELSE 'Más de 25' END

query_52.enunciado: Cursos agrupados por rango de créditos
query_52.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN Credits <= 2 THEN 'Créditos Bajos' WHEN Credits BETWEEN 3 AND 4 THEN 'Créditos Medios' ELSE 'Créditos Altos' END AS RangoCreditos, COUNT(*) AS CantidadCursos FROM Course GROUP BY CASE WHEN Credits <= 2 THEN 'Créditos Bajos' WHEN Credits BETWEEN 3 AND 4 THEN 'Créditos Medios' ELSE 'Créditos Altos' END

query_53.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.Title, p.LastName FROM Course c JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID JOIN Person p ON sg.StudentID = p.PersonID) AS SourceTable PIVOT (COUNT(LastName) FOR Title IN ([Matemáticas], [Historia], [Literatura])) AS PivotTable

query_54.enunciado: ROW_NUMBER: Ranking de estudiantes por promedio
query_54.sql: SELECT p.LastName, p.FirstName, AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) AS Promedio, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) DESC) AS Ranking FROM Person p JOIN StudentGrade sg ON p.PersonID = sg.StudentID GROUP BY p.PersonID, p.LastName, p.FirstName

query_55.sql: SELECT sg.StudentID, sg.CourseID, sg.Grade, LAG(sg.Grade) OVER (PARTITION BY sg.StudentID ORDER BY sg.CourseID) AS CalificacionAnterior FROM StudentGrade sg

query_56.enunciado: Recursive CTE: Jerarquía de departamentos (si existe)
query_56.sql: WITH Jerarquia AS (SELECT DepartmentID, Name, ParentDepartmentID FROM Department WHERE ParentDepartmentID IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT d.DepartmentID, d.Name, d.ParentDepartmentID FROM Department d INNER JOIN Jerarquia j ON d.ParentDepartmentID = j.DepartmentID) SELECT * FROM Jerarquia

query_57.sql: SELECT StudentID, CourseID, COUNT(*) AS Duplicados FROM StudentGrade GROUP BY StudentID, CourseID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

query_58.sql: SELECT c.Credits, AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) AS PromedioCalificacion FROM Course c JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY c.Credits ORDER BY c.Credits

query_59.sql: SELECT c.Title, AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) AS Promedio FROM Course c JOIN StudentGrade sg ON c.CourseID = sg.CourseID GROUP BY c.CourseID, c.Title HAVING AVG(CAST(sg.Grade AS FLOAT)) > 90 ORDER BY Promedio DESC

query_60.sql: SELECT 'Personas' AS Entidad, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM Person UNION SELECT 'Cursos' AS Entidad, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM Course UNION SELECT 'Calificaciones' AS Entidad, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM StudentGrade UNION SELECT 'Departamentos' AS Entidad, COUNT(*) AS Total FROM Department

query_61.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Person WHERE PersonType = 'Student') AS TotalEstudiantes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Person WHERE PersonType = 'Instructor') AS TotalInstructores, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Course) AS TotalCursos, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM StudentGrade) AS TotalCalificaciones, (SELECT AVG(CAST(Grade AS FLOAT)) FROM StudentGrade) AS PromedioGeneral
